remarks: A rare opportunity in Westport! This beautiful home, built in 1940, is making its debut on the market for the first time in 46 years. This property boasts timeless appeal and has the potential to become the next dream home for its new owner.  Discover a charming interior with hardwood floors, two fireplaces and the comfort of central air conditioning. The main level has versatile living and dining spaces with a bedroom and a full bath, adding flexibility and convenience to the layout. This residence presents an exceptional canvas for renovation and enhancement, allowing the new owner to imprint their vision and style. This is an opportunity to make improvements before the upcoming school year, and a seamless transition those seeking a new home close to the schools. Seize the chance to be part of the Westport community and make this well-preserved gem your own. Don't miss out on this special offering - schedule a private viewing today and discover the endless possibilities that await in this Westport treasure.
